description: Barkatullah Vishwavidyalaya, formerly Bhopal University, is a state university established in 1970 in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.

website_search_evidence.result: Command-line search responses did not expose a usable result link; direct GET verification of the expected official host bubhopal.ac.in returned the university homepage.

agent_notes: The official homepage links a 152-entry BU Program Details PDF, but the official Chemistry department page separately lists current M.Sc.(Chemistry) and Ph.D. Chemistry offerings that are absent from that central catalogue.

Because the official programme catalogue is internally incomplete and the full active programme set cannot be established without guessing, course import and career-tree mappings are withheld for manual review.

The Chemistry page explicitly states M.Sc.(Chemistry) is two years/four semesters with B.Sc. and minimum 50% Chemistry-major eligibility; these facts were not imported because the catalogue reconciliation is unresolved.
Normal TLS verification produced curl error 60 (self-signed certificate in chain) for the expected official hosts; public GETs used curl --insecure only after confirming the expected hostnames.
